cases.sentence: Левина не было дома, когда Катавасов и Сергей Иванович на тарантасике, взятом на станции, запыленные, как арапы, в двенадцатом часу дня подъехали к крыльцу ___.
cases.explain: «покровского дома» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Sergey Ivanovitch had not telegraphed to his brother to send to meet him, as he did not know when he should be able to leave Moscow. Levin was not at home when Katavasov and Sergey Ivanovitch in a fly hired at the station drove up to the steps of the Pokrovskoe house, as black as Moors from the dust of the road. Kitty, sitting on the balcony with her father and sister, recognized her brother-in-law, and ran down to meet him.

cases.sentence: Вот именно в затоне, – сказал Катавасов. – А нам в городе, кроме ___, ничего не видно.
cases.explain: «сербской войны» — after the preposition «кроме», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “Busy as ever with his farming. It really is a peaceful backwater,” said Katavasov; “while we in town think of nothing but the Serbian war. Well, how does our friend look at it? He’s sure not to think like other people.”

cases.sentence: Как на беду, не кормила уж с ___.
cases.explain: «самого чая» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “You go to them, darling,” said Kitty to her sister, “and entertain them. They saw Stiva at the station; he was quite well. And I must run to Mitya. As ill-luck would have it, I haven’t fed him since tea. He’s awake now, and sure to be screaming.” And feeling a rush of milk, she hurried to the nursery.

cases.sentence: Он теперь проснулся и, верно, кричит. – И она, чувствуя прилив молока, ___ пошла в детскую.
cases.explain: «скорым шагом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “You go to them, darling,” said Kitty to her sister, “and entertain them. They saw Stiva at the station; he was quite well. And I must run to Mitya. As ill-luck would have it, I haven’t fed him since tea. He’s awake now, and sure to be screaming.” And feeling a rush of milk, she hurried to the nursery.

cases.explain: «жадного крика» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The baby’s greedy scream was passing into sobs.
